results.title: Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards 2024 announced; four achievers to be honoured
results.description: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports on Wednesday announced four awardees for the Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards TNNAA 2024 with President Droupadi Murmu set to confer the honours at Rashtrapati Bhavan alongside the National Sports Awards 2025 The awardees include mountaineers Baljeet Kaur and Skalzang Rigzin in the Land Adventure category Rimo Saha in Water Adventure and Shiv Prasad Chamoli in the Lifetime Achievement category according to a statement from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
